comparison_rule: Match meaning and receiver domain before comparing numbers. Pass names, probe indices and atlas coordinates are not cross-engine correspondences.

stages.name: Geometry and materials
stages.rule: Match camera projection and world-space receiver; decode normals/depth and remap metres to centimetres. SC atlases require card-to-world mapping.

stages.name: Surface lighting and visibility
stages.rule: Check irradiance vs outgoing radiance, receiver albedo/pi, light intensity and exposure conventions before subtraction.

stages.name: Surface radiosity
stages.rule: Compare hit positions, visibility, outgoing radiance, update lists and history weights at corresponding surfaces, not atlas texel IDs.

stages.name: World-space cached lighting
stages.rule: DDGI SH and UE Radiance Cache have different representations. Evaluate at shared world points/directions; do not compare buffer indices directly.

stages.name: Screen probes
stages.rule: Compare current measurements separately from history, validity/confidence, sample count and spatial reconstruction.

stages.name: Composition and display
stages.rule: Match material multiplication and pre-exposure for linear data. Screenshots are display references; tone curves differ and cannot establish GI energy differences.
